<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/cases/{caseId}/agent/runs"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Runs the case agent without a person present, as the person who starts it. Every turn is bounded; the run continues in further turns until it has investigated params.maxRows rows, used the budget or finished. Write tools only create pending actions for a person to confirm; costly tools run only inside the budget. Completion fires the organisation webhook. Agent tokens cannot start runs.
